buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): By CLW's Zonal Inspection Wing at firm's OEM premises before supply of the materials. Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Not required. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only.

5. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 6. Generic Shelf Life: The Product/Spare parts to be supplied as part of the services must have minimum 12 Shelf Life. On the date of supply, minimum 12 usable shelf life should be available / balance. 7. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 9. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 10. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 11. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 12. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 13. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 14. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (1) The material to be supplied as per Specifications as per BLW's Specifications vide No. D LW/TOT/VEH/DD/PS_ADHESIVE & SEALANTS REV No. 06 dated 31/01/2007 & dated 07/09/2 0 (revision date): Sl No. Parameters Requirements 01 Density 1.44 to 1.57 g/ml

02 Skin formation time 10-65 minutes 03 Shore hardness A (ISO 868 Durometer 20 to 40 A/ASTM D2240) 04 Tensile Strength (ISO 37/ASTM D 412) 110 to 210 psi 05 Elongation at Break (according to ISO 5 350% to 480% 27-3/ASTM D412) 06 Lap Shear Strength in Steel (grit blast e 110 to 210 psi d) & tested as per ISO 4587/ASTM D 10 02 07 “T” Peel strength, [ISO 11339 (Alumini 3.3 to 6 N/mm um)/ASTM D1781/D1876] 08 Shelf Life Minimum 12 months All the participating bidders/tenderers to confirm all the technical requirements and additio nal terms and c onditions in their letter-head pad. (2) Packing Instruction: 300 ml or 310 ml. of packing size are acceptable. No other packing size will be acceptable. Packing of each sealant in individual cartridges/packs as per requir ement. Packing of product in cartoon box of appropriate size in order to sustain the weight of the sealants. The following information shall be provided on the cartoon boxes: (i) Purcha se Order No. (ii) Item Description, (iii) Part No. (if any), (iv) PO quantity, (v) Quantity packe d in the box, (vi) Year of manufacturing, (vii) Manufacturer Details. Transit Damage, if any, should be at cost of supplier. (3) Shelf Life: This is shelf life item. Shelf life of the material in the original sealed pack sho uld be greater than or equal to 12 (twelve) months. (4) Only the OEM or authorized dealer of OEM should quote. Tender Specific authorization o f OEM will require to be uploaded by the bidder, in case, dealer participating in the tender, f ailing which the offer will summarily be rejected. (5) Successful bidder should submit Manufacturer's TC & GC at the time of material deliver y. (6) Inspection Clause: Inspection to be done by CLW's zonal Inspection Wing at firm's OEM premises before supply the material. (7) Delivery Place: Free delivery to respective consignee i.e. Receipt Branch (RB) under AM M/3PHASE/ Store Department at Work shop premises (At no other placed material will be c ollected/received). (8) Mode of Dispatch: By Road/Courier at supplier's own risk, cost and arrangement on doo r delivery basis. Transit Damage if any should be at the cost of supplier. (9) After placement of contract, if any queries regarding delivery of material / clearance of CRAC or any replacement of goods, seller should contact with consignee i.e. AMM/3PHASE/I I/CLW /CRJ (contact details-916 3340716, email id- niranajn.0773@gov.in). (10) Eligibility Criteria: CLW reserves right to procure entire or bulk quantity from the firms who have supplied at least 10 loco sets (146.20 Ltrs. i.e. 472 pack of 310 ml) of the subject item to Railways, 60 days prior to the original date of opening of the tender. Firm has to en close the copy of R-Note along with their offer as a proof of supplies. (11) Bidders are requested to go through the detail specification as attached below before participate in this bid.
